messages.text: Sun-hee, you were quiet at church yesterday. Everything ok?
Took Mom to Harborview this afternoon. She had a fever and got dizzy. This morning she skipped her breakfast photo and told the family chat she was fine. She's ok now, they're keeping her overnight.
Thank you for going. I had no idea. Call me after?
Same as January. No photo this morning, then "I'm fine" in the group. I went by at lunch and she was dehydrated and confused. She's at Swedish now, on fluids. Ok now.
That's twice now. If it happens again we can't wait until the afternoon.
Agreed. I'm ten minutes away, just text me.
Started my new job today! Thanks for all the messages.
Juk again, it was cold this morning
Jun-ah, can you send me the photo from Ji-woo's graduation?
Fixed the leak under her sink. She tried to pay me in kimchi.
Chuseok lunch at my place on the 25th. Min, bring the folding table.
Rice and short rib soup, leftovers
Thank you for lunch, Sun-hee. Best galbi this year.
Pottery class Saturday? There are two spots left.
Your mother says you work too late. Eat dinner!
Can you cover Mom's eye appointment on the 29th? I have a site visit.
Mom's flu shot is done. She says hi.
For the Q4 review, I need the final deck before I present the forecast part.
It'll be in my Files as Q4_review_deck.pdf by the 21st.
Q4 review is Thursday 9:30 to noon in Rainier. Phones away, Rachel wants full focus.
Who wants persimmons? I have too many.
Me! I will make dried ones.
My bowl came out of the kiln lopsided. I love it anyway.
Can you check the churn numbers on slide 6 before Thursday?
Checked, they match the September report.
Thanks for walking me through the forecast slides today.
